description: Read the product page of one of your software items as set_product_page writes it: blocks (what visitors see), pending_blocks (your text changes waiting for review), media (every upload with id, type, size and where it appears), unplaced (screenshots in no image block, shown under "More screenshots"), hero (the clip at the top of the page), cover (the image on cards and launcher tiles), presentation (listing level with toward_ideal) and warnings (dead media ids, missing description block, no clip). Read it before set_product_page to get the media ids, and again afterwards to check that warnings is empty. Requires sign-in to your Crela account; your client asks you to connect when you first use it.
name: get_product_page
title: Read a Crela product page
